    Endpoint normal forms for the ordinary mesh ideal #

    At a fixed target, a mesh-ideal element is a left multiple of the mesh relation at that target, when it exists, plus ideal-valued coefficients followed by the incoming arrows. At a projective target the first summand is absent. The proof expands the right path-basis multiplier and peels its first reverse-quiver arrow.
